facts.business: Waaree Technologies Limited is engaged in battery manufacturing and trading of batteries and its product components, with a focus on advanced battery production techniques.

guidance_or_targets.statement: The Company is looking for a good future ahead and targeting the corresponding growth in the next year.

auditor.name: M/s. R T Jain & Co. LLP, Chartered Accountants

key_risks: Heavy reliance on specific raw materials subject to supply chain disruptions
Evolving regulations related to battery technologies and disposal requiring constant capex infusion
Highly competitive and price sensitive market
facts.related_party_note: The Company has developed a related party transactions framework through standard operating procedures for identification and monitoring of transactions with related parties. The policy on related party transactions as approved by the Board of Directors has been uploaded on the website of the Company. None of the Directors has any pecuniary relationship or transactions vis-a-vis the Company. Details of transactions entered into with the related parties are given in form AOC-2 annexed as Annexure-1.
